from pathlib import Path
import os, re, subprocess
roots=[Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components'),Path('managed_components'),Path('components'),Path.home()/'esp',Path.home()/'.espressif']
pat=re.compile(r'(zone.?status.*change|status.*change.*zone|ias_zone.*status|ZONE_STATUS_CHANGE|IAS_ZONE_STATUS|status_change_notification|zone_status_change)',re.I)
seen=set()
for root in roots:
    if not root.exists():
        continue
    print('ROOT='+str(root))
    count=0
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        if count>=500:
            break
        if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in {'.h','.c','.cc','.cpp','.inc'}:
            continue
        try:
            text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
        except Exception:
            continue
        for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
            if pat.search(line):
                key=(str(p),i,line.strip())
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key); print(f'{p}:{i}:{line.strip()}'); count+=1
                    if count>=500: break
print('=== IAS HEADER FILES ===')
for root in roots:
    if not root.exists(): continue
    for p in root.rglob('*.h'):
        n=p.name.lower()
        if 'ias' in n and 'zone' in n:
            print(p)
print('=== PUBLIC SYMBOL CANDIDATES ===')
libroots=[Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/build'),Path('build'),Path.home()/'.espressif',Path.home()/'esp']
sympat=re.compile(r'(ias.*zone.*status|zone.*status.*change|status.*change.*notif)',re.I)
printed=0
for root in libroots:
    if not root.exists(): continue
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        if printed>=300: break
        if not p.is_file() or p.suffix not in {'.a','.so','.dylib'}: continue
        try:
            out=subprocess.run(['nm','-g',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5).stdout
        except Exception:
            continue
        lines=[x for x in out.splitlines() if sympat.search(x)]
        if lines:
            print('LIB='+str(p))
            for x in lines[:30]: print(x)
            printed += len(lines[:30])
print('INVESTIGATION_COMPLETE=1')
print('REPORT_REQUIRED=Exact callable API/signature if any for IAS Zone Status Change Notification; whether EZBee exposes it; whether esp_zigbee exposes a lower-level public API; smallest standards-correct way to emit both ZoneStatus 0x0001 and 0x0000 after enrollment. Do not modify files.')
PY
